args.question: Please provide the definition of Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE).

tool_trajectory.result: Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE) is defined as the average sequence value from interactions within a session, calculated using the formula: AVG(i.seqval) OVER(PARTITION BY s.seshkey) AS avg_seqval.

args.sql:
WITH cie AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seshlink2 AS seshkey, 
        AVG(i.seqval) OVER (PARTITION BY i.seshlink2) AS avg_seqval
    FROM interactions AS i
),
sbra AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey, 
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval/100) AS bounce_impact
    FROM sessions AS s
)
SELECT 
    s.seshkey AS session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    sb.bounce_impact,
    ci.avg_seqval AS avg_seq_value,
    ci.avg_seqval / sb.bounce_impact AS rtse
FROM sessions AS s
JOIN cie AS ci ON s.seshkey = ci.seshkey
JOIN sbra AS sb ON s.seshkey = sb.seshkey;

    FROM interactions AS i
),
sbra AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey, 
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval/100) AS bounce_impact
    FROM sessions AS s
)
SELECT 
    s.seshkey AS session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    sb.bounce_impact,
    ci.avg_seqval AS avg_seq_value,
    ci.avg_seqval / sb.bounce_impact AS rtse
FROM sessions AS s
JOIN cie AS ci ON s.seshkey = ci.seshkey
JOIN sbra AS sb ON s.seshkey = sb.seshkey
WHERE sb.bounce_impact != 0;
